note: Chime — Pilgrim SMG Supporter, Burst II (cd 20s). A 'king-maker' buffer: she designates ONE ally as 'the king' (word_group=10091) and pours her buffs into it. KING TARGETING: 'the king' = the single ally with the highest ATK, modeled as alliesTopAtk count:1 with STATIC base-ATK ranking (no byFinalAtk — the kit says plain 'the king'/highest ATK, not 'final ATK', so the owner literal-word rule keeps base ranking; the designation is fixed at battle start, which matches the engine evaluating the ranking once). Datamined base ATK 500 puts Chime above most B2 carries she is paired with (e.g. Crown 400), so without excludeSelf the selector would resolve to Chime herself; excludeSelf is ON so the buff lands on the intended carry. Whether the kit's 'ally' wording strictly excludes the caster is unverified (⚑, recipe: focus video showing which unit carries the king icon, or the datamined target flag for word_group 10091). S1 (Chief Aide, 'start of battle ... continuously'): Wish — the king gets ATK ▲46.46% OF CHIME'S OWN ATK as a permanent flat add → casterAtkPct 46.46, passive trigger, NO durationSec (continuous). NOTE the caster-basis: this is % of the SKILL USER's ATK (Chime, a Supporter), NOT % of the king's own ATK — atkPct would massively over-buff a high-ATK carry and is the nearest-wrong counterfactual. S2 (The King's Secretary, 'when entering Full Burst'): Daily Report — the king gets Normal Attack Damage Multiplier ▲46.22% for 10s → normalAttackPct 46.22 (scales the normal-attack multiplier), fullBurstEnter trigger, 10s. BURST (For the King, cast at Stage 2): (a) all allies — Re-enters Burst Stage 2 → reenterStage stage:2 (the rotation holds at stage 2 so a SECOND eligible B2 can also cast this rotation — the Tia/Anis:Star re-entry mechanic; behaviorally live only when a 2nd B2 is present) + Max Ammunition Capacity ▲20% for 10s → maxAmmoPct 20/10s (a weapon-state modifier: more shots before reload); (b) the king — Loyalty: Attack Damage ▲92.44% for 10s → attackDamagePct 92.44/10s (Damage Up bucket). Her own SMG normal damage is minor; her value is the king buffs + the B2 re-entry, so a /sim-battery board diff is the real check. NO lines dropped — the kit has NO defensive/heal/shield/taunt portions; every line is a damage-relevant buff or the burst re-entry, so all three unmodeled arrays are empty.
